Thanks again for taking time this morning. Attached is our first-pass timeline for the 2026 annual reviews (file: 2026_review_timeline_v1.xlsx). Key questions we flagged:

- Stagger window for ICs vs managers to reduce overlap (proposal: leadership notified week of Jan 9, managers start calibration Jan 16)

Thanks Sophie — looked through the spreadsheet. A few rapid thoughts:

- Staggered rollout: I prefer a phased notify approach. Week 1: managers-only calibration and compensations committee prep. Week 2: private notifications for sensitive roles (HR + Legal in the room). Week 3: broader manager notifications.
- Please treat the sensitive-role list as privileged. I'm attaching a working list (sensitive_roles_list.csv). Limit editors to neha, hannah, me, and Sophie.
- Legal sign-off should be gated before any compensation changes are routed to finance. We should build a single sign-off artifact (DocuSign or signed PDF) per employee where compensation or title changes occur.

Action items I will own this week: consolidate approvals path and share a single-sheet "decision ledger" for sign-offs. If FinLegal needs additional artifacts, let me know.

— Marcus

- Communications windows: provide a 48-hour buffer between manager notification and employee notification for sensitive cases (so we can triage support requests).
- Templates: Sophie, can PeopleOps draft two manager templates — one redacted and one full — so managers know what to say if asked?

Couple of flag items from comp & finance:

- If we do per-employee DocuSign sign-offs for compensation/title changes, finance needs a 3-business-day window to process retro/plan adjustments for any effective dates in Jan. That pushes some operational milestones earlier.
- For high-impact sales changes that affect OTEs, we need interim quota guidance to avoid accidental over/under-payments.

Recommend: move manager calibration earlier by 3 days and lock the compensation approval window one week earlier. Happy to coordinate with finance to model the impact — suggest we add finance as a reviewer on the master timeline.

4) DocuSign: Sophie/FinLegal to confirm envelope templates by Dec 10 so HR can test.
5) Escalations: regulatory-impact items route to Legal + Security within 24 hours.

Action owners:
- Neha: lock sensitive list and confirm redaction workflow (due Dec 6)
- Markus: confirm finance processing windows and provide sample timelines by Dec 7
- Sophie: finalize manager templates and DocuSign template coordination by Dec 10
- Laura: schedule manager calibration sessions and share invites (by Dec 14)
- Me (Marcus): produce the single-sheet approvals ledger and share with execs (by Dec 8)

I'll update the drive folder with the consolidated timeline and invite reviewers. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — this sequencing should minimize risk and give managers the clarity they need.

— Marcus
